atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the `@tailwind` directive to insert Tailwind's `base`, `components`, `utilities` and `screens` styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use the `@apply` directive to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the `@layer` directive to tell Tailwind which “bucket” a set of custom styles belong to.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Use the `@config` directive to specify which config file Tailwind should use.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use `@theme` to define design tokens (colors, spacing, fonts, etc.) that Tailwind generates utilities from.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use `@utility` to define custom utility classes in Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use `@custom-variant` to define custom variants in Tailwind CSS v4.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use `@variant` to apply a Tailwind variant inside custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Use `@plugin` to load a Tailwind plugin from CSS.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use `@source` to register additional source files for Tailwind class detection.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Use `@reference` to import another CSS file for Tailwind without emitting its styles.
